# AI Engineer — Quillmark (fictional)

Quillmark helps legal teams review contracts with language models. Amsterdam, hybrid (three days in the office).

## You have

- 4+ years of software engineering experience.
- Python and TypeScript.
- Experience building RAG pipelines with a vector database such as pgvector, Qdrant or Pinecone.
- Experience designing evaluations for model outputs.
- Ownership of features from idea to production.

## Bonus

- Knowledge of the legal domain.
- Experience with the Vercel AI SDK.
- Dutch is a plus.

We offer a relocation package and visa support for moving to Amsterdam.
